outputs.answer_text: At 25 °C and 20 minutes, catalyst X yielded 72%, compared with 31% without it, a 41-percentage-point difference. Each condition was repeated three times. The study does not establish long-term stability or behavior at other temperatures.
The means were 41.2 for control, 48.0 at dose 5, and 55.1 at dose 10 (n=6 each). This proves a statistically significant dose effect.
Formulation F retained 92% after 7 days at 4 °C. Samples were protected from light, so the formulation is stable; longer storage was not measured.

Method C has the highest mean recovery, 83% versus B's 81%. Both use 20 mL, but C takes 30 minutes rather than 15. Each mean has three replicates, and no significance test supports calling C significantly better.
